sections.heading: THE REALITY
sections.body: Partner distribution is not the same experience as seeking a loan for your own business. Referral opportunities may involve different training, eligibility, compliance and compensation rules, so current program terms should be verified before participation.

sections.heading: HOW TO APPROACH IT
sections.body: Core explains the available partner pathways, then hands qualified interest to the designated partner property or existing Wix partner page after verification.

sections.heading: YOUR NEXT MOVE
sections.body: Review participation terms and the support model; never interpret illustrative compensation as a promise of earnings.

complianceNotes: Editorial draft; no invented financial product terms.
